item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President establishes an internal executive board, assigns it policy-guidance, coordination, evaluation, and reporting functions, and specifies its membership; these are administrative organization duties rather than changes to legal rights.","evidence":"There is hereby established a Psychological Strategy Board"},{"segment_id":"2","code":4,"rationale":"The segment inseparably combines internal organization and staffing directions with a presently fixed compensation entitlement for the Director, which is a distinct self-executing legal consequence.","evidence":"who shall receive compensation of $16,000 per year"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The segment assigns internal staffing control, interagency assistance, information access, administrative review, and resource-use responsibilities, without dictating a later legally consequential outcome.","evidence":"The heads of the departments and agencies concerned shall examine into present arrangements"}]}
